controles.affirmation: fondamental_interne #4 : 'Le DOJ a depose plainte le 22 decembre 2025 devant le tribunal federal du Maryland contre Black & Decker (U.S.) Inc.'
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Note O Contingencies : 'On December 22, 2025, DOJ filed suit in the U.S. District Court for the District of Maryland related to the matter, naming Black & Decker (U.S.) Inc. as a defendant. The Company believes that it took timely and appropriate action and intends to vigorously defend itself against the claims brought by DOJ.'

controles.affirmation: fondamental_interne #4 : 'la CPSC avait recommande une penalite civile d'environ 32 M$ pour ce dossier ... pour signalement tardif de deux rappels'
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Note O : 'on January 19, 2024, the Company was notified by the Compliance and Field Operations Division (the "Division") of the Consumer Product Safety Commission ("CPSC") that the Division INTENDED TO RECOMMEND the imposition of a civil penalty of approximately $32 million for ALLEGED untimely reporting in relation to certain utility bars and miter saws.' Deux ecarts : (1) c'est la Division de conformite qui avait l'INTENTION de recommander, la CPSC elle-meme n'a jamais 'recommande' une penalite ; elle a seulement vote le renvoi du dossier au DOJ ('On May 1, 2024, the Company was informed that the CPSC voted to refer the matter to the DOJ'). (2) le signalement tardif est ALLEGUE, pas etabli. Le document ajoute par ailleurs : 'The Company does not expect that any sum it may have to pay in connection with this matter, including any reserved amount, will have a materially adverse effect on its financial position, results of operations or liquidity.'
controles.correction_proposee: 'la division de conformite de la CPSC avait annonce en janvier 2024 son intention de recommander une penalite civile d'environ 32 M$ pour signalement pretendument tardif de deux rappels (barres a outils et scies a onglets) ; la CPSC a ensuite vote le renvoi du dossier au DOJ en mai 2024. La societe conteste et estime qu'aucune somme eventuelle n'aurait d'effet significatif sur sa situation financiere.'

controles.affirmation: fondamental_interne #5 : 'action collective Rammohan (District du Connecticut, deposee en mars 2023) ... deuxieme version de la plainte PROPOSEE en octobre 2025'
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Note O : 'on March 24, 2023, a putative class action lawsuit titled Naresh Vissa Rammohan v. Stanley Black & Decker, Inc., et al., Case No. 3:23-cv-00369-KAD... was filed in the United States District Court for the District of Connecticut... The complaint asserted violations of Sections 10(b) and 20(a) of the Exchange Act and Rule 10b-5 based on allegedly false and misleading statements related to consumer demand for the Company's products amid changing COVID-19 trends and macroeconomic conditions.' ; 'Lead Plaintiff provided Defendants with a proposed second amended complaint on October 30, 2025'. Reserve : l'ATT s'arrete a la version PROPOSEE alors que le document poursuit : 'Lead Plaintiff subsequently filed its Second Amended Complaint on November 14, 2025... Defendants filed a renewed motion to dismiss on December 18, 2025... Defendants filed a reply in support of their renewed motion to dismiss on February 19, 2026.' L'etat de la procedure decrit est donc perime de 4 mois.
controles.correction_proposee: Actualiser : 'la deuxieme plainte modifiee a ete deposee le 14 novembre 2025 ; la requete en rejet renouvelee des defendeurs est instruite depuis fevrier 2026'.

controles.affirmation: quantitatif #2 : 'Marge brute de 33,0% au T2 2026 contre 27,0% au T2 2025 ; l'ecart de 6 points depasse largement la progression de la marge brute ajustee, qui ressort a 30,7% (+0,7 point)'
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Cost of Sales and Gross Profit : 'Gross profit... was $1.306 billion, or 33.0% of net sales, in the second quarter of 2026 compared to $1.067 billion, or 27.0% of net sales, in the second quarter of 2025... Excluding these adjustments, gross profit was 33.7% OF NET SALES FOR THE THREE MONTHS ENDED JULY 4, 2026, COMPARED TO 27.5% of net sales for the three months ended June 28, 2025.' La marge brute AJUSTEE du trimestre progresse donc de +6,2 points (33,7% contre 27,5%), soit autant que la marge publiee : l'argument de l'ATT s'effondre. Le 30,7% cite provient de .batches-drafts-safe/kpis-haut/SWK.json, champ adj_gross_margin, qui est une valeur ANNUELLE FY2025 ('30,7% en 2025 vs 30,0% en 2024', last_data_date 2026-01-03). L'ATT compare un trimestre a un exercice complet.
controles.correction_proposee: Le document identifie lui-meme le vrai element non recurrent, a citer a la place : 'le gain de 6 points s'explique en partie par un benefice d'environ 250 points de base lie au net des remboursements de droits de douane realises' (verbatim : 'in addition to a benefit of approximately 250 basis points related to the net impact of tariff refunds realized as described above'). Marge brute ajustee reelle du T2 2026 : 33,7% contre 27,5%.

controles.affirmation: fondamental_interne #2 : 'la croissance organique du segment Tools & Outdoor ressort a -2% sur la periode, la hausse affichee du CA venant surtout du change et du prix'
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Business Segment Results : 'Tools & Outdoor net sales increased $102.9 million, or 3.0%, in the second quarter of 2026... as a 3% INCREASE IN VOLUME and a 1% increase from foreign currency were partially offset by a 1% decrease from strategic outdoor product line transitions. ORGANIC REVENUE INCREASED 3%, primarily driven by power tools strength in U.S. retail and commercial and industrial channels.' Sur le semestre : 'Tools & Outdoor organic revenues increased 1%'. La croissance organique publiee est donc +3% (T2) et +1% (S1), pas -2%. Le -2% provient de kpis-haut/SWK.json (champ tools_outdoor_organic, sans last_data_date, signal date de 'mi-2025') : donnee perimee. De plus, la hausse du T2 vient d'abord du VOLUME (+3 pts), pas du change ni du prix.
controles.correction_proposee: 'la croissance organique du segment ressort a +3% au T2 2026 et +1% sur le semestre, tiree par le volume en outillage electroportatif ; le CA reste neanmoins sous son niveau du T2 2022 (3 745 M$).' Ne pas reutiliser le champ tools_outdoor_organic de kpis-haut, perime.

controles.affirmation: fondamental_interne #2 : 'Tools & Outdoor pese 3,564 Mds $ au T2 2026, comparable aux 3,745 Mds $ du T2 2022 et aux 3,461 Mds $ du T2 2025'
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Note segments : 'Net Sales | $ 3,564.3 | $ 396.4 | $ 3,960.7' et comparatif T2 2025 '3,461.4'. 10-Q T2 2022 : Tools & Outdoor '3,744.9'.

controles.affirmation: fondamental_interne #1 : 'Benefice net T2 2026 351,3 M$ incluant un gain de 273,7 M$ sur la vente de CAM ; CA consolide +0,4% (3 960,7 contre 3 945,2)'
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Condensed Consolidated Statements of Operations : 'Net Sales $3,960.7 $3,945.2' ; '(Gain) loss on sales of businesses ( 273.7 )' ; 'Net Earnings $351.3 $101.9'. Precision : les 273,7 M$ sont un gain AVANT impot inscrit au compte de resultat, pas une contribution nette de 273,7 M$ au benefice net de 351,3 M$.
controles.correction_proposee: Optionnel, pour le hook : '273,7 M$ de gain avant impot viennent de la vente d'une activite'.

controles.affirmation: fondamental_interne #3 : 'Engineered Fastening -18% au T2 2026, dont 21 points lies a la cession CAM ; volume sous-jacent +2% ; segment a 396,4 M$'
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : 'Engineered Fastening net sales decreased 18% compared to the second quarter of 2025 as a 21% decrease from the CAM business divestiture was partially offset by a 2% increase in volume and a 1% increase in price.' et 'Engineered Fastening net sales decreased $87.4 million, or 18.1%'. Le document precise aussi : 'Engineered Fastening organic revenues increased 3%'.

controles.affirmation: fondamental_externe #1 : citation guidance 'assume that the temporary tariff tailwind in 2026 driven by the ruling on IEEPA tariffs ... will be offset by higher inflation, primarily driven by battery metals, tungsten, and oil derivatives'
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, 2026 Guidance : 'the above guidance ranges assume that the temporary tariff tailwind in 2026 driven by the ruling on IEEPA tariffs, which were at higher levels than the Section 122 tariffs that replaced them through late July, will be offset by higher inflation, primarily driven by battery metals, tungsten, and oil derivatives.'

controles.affirmation: fondamental_externe #2 (preuve) : citation attribuee au 10-Q T2 2026 : 'the Company and its suppliers may rely on one or very few suppliers or suppliers concentrated in certain regions ... in April 2025, China restricted export of certain rare earth minerals'
controles.verbatim_source: Le premier fragment n'existe PAS dans le 10-Q T2 2026 (aucune occurrence de 'one or very few suppliers', ni du mot 'cobalt'). Il figure dans le 10-K FY2025 (data-lake/SWK/_risks_src_30k.txt) : 'cobalt, the Company and its suppliers may rely on one or very few suppliers or suppliers concentrated in certain regions'. Le second fragment est une paraphrase, pas un verbatim : le 10-Q ecrit 'in April 2025, China IMPOSED EXPORT RESTRICTIONS on certain rare earth minerals that are used in certain components of the Company's products, which resulted in delays and shortages of certain components.'
controles.correction_proposee: Attribuer le premier fragment au 10-K FY2025 et corriger le second en verbatim : 'in April 2025, China imposed export restrictions on certain rare earth minerals... which resulted in delays and shortages of certain components' (10-Q T2 2026).

controles.affirmation: fondamental_externe #2 : 'la restriction chinoise a deja cause des SURCOUTS et des perturbations de production selon le document'
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : la seule consequence deja survenue mentionnee est 'which resulted in DELAYS AND SHORTAGES of certain components'. La hausse des couts n'est evoquee qu'au conditionnel et pour un scenario futur : 'the Company may not be able to obtain sufficient quantities, or obtain supply in a timely manner, or at a commercially reasonable cost' et 'may result in an increase in its manufacturing costs'. Aucun surcout constate n'est chiffre ni affirme.
controles.correction_proposee: 'ce qui a deja provoque des retards et des penuries sur certains composants, la societe indiquant par ailleurs que de nouvelles restrictions pourraient renchérir ses couts de production'.

controles.affirmation: fondamental_externe #3 : citation 'there can be no assurance that any refunds will be available to it in amounts or within timeframes that would meaningfully offset the impact of tariffs'
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Item 1A : 'While the Company has submitted refund claims, and may submit additional refund claims, for eligible IEEPA tariffs paid, the ultimate amounts the Company may recover remain uncertain, and there can be no assurance that any refunds will be available to it in amounts or within timeframes that would meaningfully offset the impact of tariffs or costs associated with tariff mitigation strategies on the Company's business.'

Le mot 'employees' et le chiffre 43 500 n'apparaissent nulle part dans le 10-Q T2 2026. La phrase 'approximately 43,500 employees in 59 countries' figure dans le 10-K FY2025 (data-lake/SWK/_risks_src_30k.txt). Le fait est exact, la source citee ne l'est pas.
controles.correction_proposee: Remplacer la source par '10-K FY2025' pour ce point.

controles.affirmation: resume + fondamental_interne : 'programme d'economies de 2,1 Mds $ termine'
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : 'The program was completed as of the end of 2025 and generated approximately $2.1 billion of pre-tax run-rate savings, exceeding its original cost savings target' (objectif initial 2,0 Mds $).

controles.affirmation: quantitatif #1 : 'Dette LT brute de 4 803,7 M$ au 4 juillet 2026 contre 5 258,1 M$ au 3 janvier 2026, tresorerie 592,4 M$ ; dette nette -42% sur un an'
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : 'Total Long-term debt, including current maturities $ 4,803.7 ... $ 5,258.1' et 'Cash and cash equivalents totaled $592.4 million as of July 4, 2026'. Le -42,2% provient de kpis-haut/SWK.json (net_debt_q, last_data_date 2026-07-04), coherent avec le desendettement decrit dans le 10-Q : 'net short-term commercial paper repayments of $1.750 billion'. Reserve : la comparaison bilancielle citee (juillet 2026 contre janvier 2026) porte sur 6 mois, alors que le -42% est un glissement annuel ; les deux ne se recoupent pas directement.
controles.correction_proposee: Preciser que les 4 803,7 M$ / 5 258,1 M$ couvrent un semestre et que le -42% de dette nette est un glissement sur douze mois.
